svg.title: Reference sheet: Pip
svg.text: front: her left on our right
White calico kitten (drawn 0.82×), blue eyes. Ginger LEFT face and flank; black RIGHT ear and flank;
a black shoulder spot and tail tip. A too-big pale blue kerchief (its point hangs to her paws)
and a shiny bottle cap on a string, worn as a medal.
